purpose: Blind candidate pool input schema for the frozen Warm high-confidence price prediction protocol.
row_requirement: Provide a candidate pool large enough to contain at least 100 rows satisfying the fixed high-confidence rule. Labels must not be included in the prediction input file.

required_columns.hcoef_stable: Frozen Warm/HCOEF stable base log-price prediction.
required_columns.svc_numeric_seed_mean: Comparable-artwork numeric seed mean log-price candidate.
required_columns.l10_seq_pred_log: Warm L10 sequential feature log-price candidate.
required_columns.quantile_width: Warm L10 quantile width, q90_log - q10_log.
required_columns.l10_price_range_ratio: L10 price range ratio around the center prediction.

optional_metadata_columns._track6_row_id: Stable internal row identifier. Used for deterministic sorting and label join if available.
optional_metadata_columns.external_artwork_id: External artwork identifier. Used for deterministic sorting and label join if _track6_row_id is unavailable.
optional_metadata_columns.title: Artwork title.

prediction_output_columns.blind_high_confidence_eligible: Whether the row satisfied the fixed high-confidence rule.
prediction_output_columns.blind_selected_for_evaluation: Whether the row was selected into the fixed 100-row evaluation subset.
prediction_output_columns.high_confidence_risk_score: Feature-only ranking score. Lower is more reliable.
